metadata.description: Razgon 2D Studio: voiceover/script → cinematic code-rendered 2D video (also runs on Android/Termux).

plugins.name: razgon-2d-studio
plugins.description: Turn a voiceover or a script into a finished MP4: story breakdown, style choice, coded shots, frame render, music and SFX. Ships a phone-friendly render path (system Chromium, no Playwright browser) and Termux setup scripts.
